{{Top|leg}}
A '''Digital lockpick''' was a class of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] that consisted of a cybernetic appendage, usually a finger, equipped with a number of small tools to assist in cracking both physical and electronic locks.

One model of Digital lockpick was the [["Jailbreak" cyberpick]]
